text:
A black plastic tube rack sits on a white bench surface in the foreground, viewed from the side at eye level. The rack has two rows of circular openings; the front row shows five visible empty holes, and the back row's openings are also visible and unoccupied except at the far right. In the rightmost back position stands one upright conical centrifuge tube, capped with an orange screw cap, holding a red liquid that fills roughly the upper portion of the tube body, with the meniscus visible near the top.

Behind the rack is a laboratory background: a white wall and cabinet, grey aluminium extrusion framing, a black cable running vertically, and a blue and grey machine at lower left.
